details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. It presents a consistent narrative of weakened H1 2026 performance with declining revenues and profits, while highlighting a stronger second quarter and record order book as mitigating factors. All statements logically support each other: the overall decline is explained by lower margins in construction services (S6, S8, S9) and reduced real estate volumes (S10, S11), while the second-quarter improvement is attributed to major projects moving into active construction phases (S2). The order book growth (S13-S15) and upcoming Rūdninkai project (S16) provide forward-looking positivity that contrasts with current earnings weakness. Financial metrics are presented without internal contradictions, and the summary concludes by synthesizing these elements into a coherent overall assessment (S20). No self-contradictions, logical gaps, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetition are present.
